servinfo.title: Front Strut Assembly Removal and Installation

attention4.ptxt: The following nuts are pre-coated with friction stabilizer. If these nuts are reused, they may work loose.

attention3.ptxt: Pulling steering knuckle outward with drive shaft fixed to steering knuckle could cause drive shaft to be removed from transaxle.
Do not pull steering knuckle outward.
If drive shaft is removed, replace drive shaft circlip with new one.

When servicing strut assembly components, loosen strut support upper nut a little before removing strut assembly. This will facilitate service work. Note that the nut must not be removed at this point.

s1.ptxt: Hoist vehicle, allowing front suspension to be free of vehicle weight.
Remove stabilizer joint nut while holding stud using hexagon wrench (2) and then disconnect stabilizer upper joint (1) from strut (3).
Remove front brake hose strut bolt (1), to detach brake hose (2) from front strut (4).
Detach front wheel speed sensor harness (3) from front strut.
Remove strut bracket nuts (5) and bolts (6).
Remove strut support upper nut (1) and rebound stopper (2), and then remove front strut assembly from vehicle.

attention3.ptxt: Hold strut assembly by hand so that it will not fall off.

servinfosub.title: Installation
servinfosub.ptxt: Reverse removal procedure noting the following points.

item.ptxt: Insert strut bracket bolts (1) in the direction shown in figure.
Tighten strut bracket nuts, front brake hose strut bolt (3) and stabilizer joint nut (4) to specified torque.
Install front wheel speed sensor harness by fitting its grommet (5) on hook of bracket (6).

attention3.ptxt: Do not twist brake hose and front wheel speed sensor harness when installing them.

item.ptxt: Tighten wheel nuts to specified torque.
Lower hoist with vehicle in unloaded condition, and then tighten new strut support upper nut (7) to specified torque.
After completing installation, check front wheel alignment.
